side_support.story: Fixed plane at the bottom, 10 N down from the top plate, 5 N sideways each way at the top.

rw_support.story: Bearing seat at the top (wheel weight 2.4 N, a 6 N couple from the motor torque, 2 N sideways), fixed plane at the base.

bottom_plate.story: Both ends fixed; 10 N motor in the middle, 5 N battery loads either side, 3.5 N bearing pull below.
